listing.name: EA Sports UFC 3 — UFC 3 native PS4 port (UFC3Native) (GNSB)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports playable menus, fights, audio, controls and saves, with limited career fixes. Portcove has not confirmed long-session memory use, performance or campaign completion. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS4 CUSA06534 base game and update 1.14.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On Windows, use UFC3.exe from the project’s 0.1.9 ZIP, or follow the Linux source build. Merge your own CUSA06534 base game and update 1.14 with merge_update.py. The runtime continues to read your game files. The recorded review did not validate the package.

warnings: The project reports playable menus, fights, audio, controls and saves, with limited career fixes. Portcove has not confirmed long-session memory use, performance or campaign completion.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
